description: This file defines the 'EmployeeTerminationRecord' entity class, representing a record of employee termination details in the HRM system, including properties such as termination date, note, termination reason, and associated employee.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecord
classes.description: Entity class representing a termination record for an employee, including properties for termination date, reason, note, and associated employee.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the termination record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the termination record.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the optional note associated with the termination record.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the termination record.

methods.name: getTerminationReason
methods.description: Returns the termination reason entity associated.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee entity associated with this termination record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with this termination record.
